title: BMUda TIKAnyn Kyrgyzstandagy coordinator menen zholugushuu bolup otttu

blocks.text: 2025-zhildyn 19-June K. Karasaev atyndagy Bishkek mamlekettik universityinde Turkiya Republicsynyn Kyzmattashtyk zhana Coordination Agenttiginin (TIKA) Kyrgyzstandagy coordinator Mehmet Bodur myrza menen zholugushuu bolup ottү.

Zholugushuuda bilim beruzhana ilim tarmagyndagy kyzmattashtyk maseleleri, birgeleshken dolboorlordu ishke ashyruu mumkunchuluktoru talkkuulandy. Oshondoy ele taraptar dolboorlordu yushturuuga ylayiktuu ayanttar menen taanyshyp, kelechekte ishke ashyrylluuchu bagyttar boyuncha pikir alyshty.
